paragraphs: Yusta the tailor: in Midrash Chazit, on ‘I knew not; my soul set me,’ he found favor in the king’s eyes, and the king gave him rule over Sepphoris; see there.
Know that there are many variations and interchanges among Yose, Yosef, Yusta, and Yustina. I did not wish to lay a hand on them, and copied them as found. You, see and become wise.
